$comment: SOVEREIGN'S HAND VOICE MANIFEST. Built by prototype-v0.2/voice/build-voice.mjs from the game's own text; do not edit by hand. Playback rule (Crownfall's): approved recording -> play it; no recording -> silence, the text still shows. Never a synthetic voice. PROPOSED extras are NOT listed here until approved. `recorded` will be maintained by the import step once files exist.

packs.name: Campaign cast
packs.description: Narrator, the Arena announcer (Crownfall's locked voice) and the 55 champions.

voices.speaker: Narration
voices.accent: Warm, neutral British storyteller. Deliberately NOT Irish, so the Narrator never sounds like the Announcer.
voices.tone: Warm, ceremonial, quietly wry. Many narration lines are card lore that end on a dry twist: let the twist land without winking.

voices.speaker: The Arena
voices.accent: Irish. LOCKED: the same voice and performer as the Crownfall announcer (Crownfall docs/ANNOUNCER.md, locked 2026-10-01).
voices.tone: Warm, regal, controlled, cinematic, slightly mysterious. Authoritative without shouting. Never robotic, overly theatrical, movie-trailer, constantly angry, shrill, cartoonish or overly cheerful.

voices.speaker: Solara
voices.tone: Gentle, earnest, quietly stubborn; blesses people without asking

voices.speaker: Solenne Ash
voices.tone: Blunt, loyal, impatient; a dry humour most people miss

voices.speaker: Kael
voices.tone: Earnest, polite, quietly stubborn; never boasts

voices.speaker: Rowan
voices.tone: Relaxed, friendly, dryly funny; serious only about careless shots

voices.speaker: Elara
voices.tone: Brisk, practical, warm underneath; no patience for reckless heroics

voices.speaker: Aurelia
voices.tone: Commanding, quick-witted, proud, fair

voices.speaker: General Varr
voices.tone: Gruff, patient, steady; remembers every soldier he lost

voices.speaker: Sol
voices.accent: Soft and placeless; no clear accent
voices.tone: Calm, gentle, ancient, faintly amused, quietly unsettling

voices.speaker: Fen
voices.accent: Low and terse; an optional hard Nordic edge (he learned from the winters)
voices.tone: Quiet, watchful, blunt

voices.speaker: Grizz
voices.tone: Loud, warm, simple, joyful

voices.speaker: Rask
voices.accent: No real-world accent; a faint hiss (lean on the s sounds)
voices.tone: Calm, confident, a little theatrical; courteous to good fighters

voices.speaker: Emberling
voices.tone: Bubbly, curious, impulsive, kind

voices.speaker: Mirella
voices.accent: Soft coastal lilt (for example Welsh or Cornish; not Irish)
voices.tone: Gentle, thoughtful, a little shy, deeply caring

voices.speaker: Ignara
voices.tone: Calm, stoic, dryly funny, quietly lonely

voices.speaker: Pyrax
voices.tone: Bold, cheerful, competitive; a hidden fear of not being enough

voices.speaker: Aurex
voices.tone: Grave, proud, weary, quietly sorrowful; grief worn like armour

voices.speaker: Pip
voices.tone: Pure joy with a short fuse; talks about himself as "Pip"

voices.speaker: Bolt
voices.accent: Flat and neutral; light metallic processing
voices.tone: Loyal, literal, quietly stubborn; lonely underneath

voices.speaker: Gearwick-9
voices.tone: Precise, patient, dryly secretive

voices.speaker: HEX-3
voices.tone: Anxious, honest, quietly brave; always a small warning attached

voices.speaker: Professor Spark
voices.tone: Boundless enthusiasm, genuinely puzzled by complaints

voices.speaker: Torren
voices.tone: Calm, gentle, slow to speak; fierce only when someone is in danger

voices.speaker: Borin Ironbelly
voices.tone: Warm, loud, generous, boastful; shares the credit

voices.speaker: Knuckle
voices.tone: Cocky, cheerful, blunt; bigger heart than his boasting

voices.speaker: Titan Rho
voices.tone: Solemn, steady, unshakeably loyal; sadness, never despair

voices.speaker: ATLAS-Ω
voices.accent: Very deep, flat, emotionless; heavier processing
voices.tone: Calm, patient, enormously restrained

voices.speaker: Bramble
voices.tone: Brave, honest, a little clumsy; takes everything seriously

voices.speaker: Thorn
voices.tone: Suspicious, protective; a threat dressed as an invitation

voices.speaker: Hexie
voices.tone: Mischievous, bold, good-hearted

voices.speaker: Maeve
voices.tone: Calm, polite, quietly frightening; never raises her voice

voices.speaker: Vessimer
voices.accent: Courteous, academic, neutral; slightly muffled by the mask
voices.tone: Curious and precise, with sudden bursts of excitement

voices.speaker: Gaia Prime
voices.tone: Patient, wise, gently unknowable; a quiet sadness

voices.speaker: Mother Verdant
voices.tone: Warm, patient, endlessly gentle, with a strength that never bends

voices.speaker: Grimm
voices.tone: Dutiful, faintly weary, dry; keeping count, not complaining

voices.speaker: Dreadmouth
voices.accent: Very deep, wet, guttural; processing allowed
voices.tone: Hunger as a sigh, not a roar; a sorrow it has stopped noticing

voices.speaker: Morrow
voices.tone: Tired, precise, a little stern, quietly kind

voices.speaker: The Unwritten King
voices.tone: Grave, measured, utterly certain

voices.speaker: Nyx
voices.tone: Cheeky, quietly proud; whispering is a habit

voices.speaker: Shade
voices.pronoun: it (as the lore file writes it)
voices.tone: Cold, clipped, final; "Good." is its only warmth

voices.speaker: Queen Vespera
voices.tone: Regal, unhurried, faintly amused

voices.speaker: Noctara
voices.tone: Absolute and certain on the surface; doubt underneath

voices.speaker: Kira Volt
voices.tone: Confident, cheerful; names her batteries

voices.speaker: Ronin Zero
voices.accent: Calm, formal, neutral (no put-on accent); light electrical processing optional
voices.tone: Calm, formal, polite; never a boast

voices.speaker: Lady Volt
voices.accent: Aristocratic, old-fashioned English; a light French flourish suits "Touché"
voices.tone: Gracious, teasing, supremely confident

voices.speaker: Dax Meridian
voices.tone: Relaxed, dry, endlessly amused; serious only about losing

voices.speaker: Captain Blacktide
voices.tone: Booming, greedy, sentimental, secretly kind

voices.speaker: Zyrak
voices.tone: Gentle, curious, a little prim, extremely polite

voices.speaker: Veilwalker
voices.accent: Layered, breathy whisper; non-verbal for its tearing cue
voices.tone: Silent, patient, strange; never cruel

voices.speaker: Veyra Sol
voices.tone: Quiet, dry, certain

voices.speaker: Seren
voices.tone: Sunny, chatty, fearless

voices.speaker: Valkara
voices.tone: Formal, fair, quietly funny

voices.speaker: Orion
voices.tone: Quiet, gentle, dryly funny

voices.speaker: Astryon
voices.tone: Grand, proud, theatrical, honourable

voices.speaker: Elysian
voices.tone: Calm, warm, immovable

voices.speaker: Crownless
voices.tone: Almost silent; short, calm, final; never cruel, never cheerful

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: OPTIONAL title card: the Act I campaign map opens for the first time.
lines.direction: Title card: clear and ceremonial. Read it as "Act One. The Shattered Crown."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: OPTIONAL title card: the Chapter One prologue panel opens, before its first line.
lines.direction: Title card: clear and ceremonial. Read it as "Chapter One. The First Light."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Prologue panel opens (automatically on the first visit to Chapter 1, or via the "Prologue" button). Line 1 of 4, in order.
lines.text: Long ago, the Crown fell. Its pieces scattered across every realm.
lines.direction: Opening line of the whole campaign. Slow storybook gravity; let "fell" land.

lines.speaker: The Arena
lines.trigger: Prologue panel opens (automatically on the first visit to Chapter 1, or via the "Prologue" button). Line 2 of 4, in order.
lines.direction: Ceremonial awe, unhurried. (Same words as Crownfall match.welcome.01: reuse that recording.)

lines.speaker: The Arena
lines.trigger: Prologue panel opens (automatically on the first visit to Chapter 1, or via the "Prologue" button). Line 3 of 4, in order.
lines.text: Welcome, Sovereign. Watch, learn, and rise.
lines.direction: Warm welcome. (Same words as Crownfall tutorial.first_match.01: reuse that recording.)

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Prologue panel opens (automatically on the first visit to Chapter 1, or via the "Prologue" button). Line 4 of 4, in order.
lines.text: The Realm and the Dawn are first to answer your banner. Before the Arena grants you a Crowning, you must earn their trust, one Bout at a time.
lines.direction: Warm and inviting; the call to begin.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The First Morning" node. Line 1 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: A young novice waits at the edge of the sparring ring, a lamp in her hands.
lines.direction: Gentle and quiet, an early morning.

lines.speaker: Solara
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The First Morning" node. Line 2 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Soft blessing, sincere.

lines.speaker: Solara
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The First Morning" node. Line 3 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: My order says the Crown is the first sunrise, stolen. Help me prove I am ready to bring it back.
lines.direction: Earnest, a little nervous; hopeful on "Help me".

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Night Watch" node. Line 1 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Night falls on the floating kingdom, and something moves between the pillars.
lines.direction: Low, slightly ominous.

lines.speaker: Solenne Ash
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Night Watch" node. Line 2 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Hard, clipped battle greeting.

lines.speaker: Solenne Ash
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Night Watch" node. Line 3 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: They strike from the dark and the side. Strike first, and they have nothing.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (blunt, loyal, impatient).

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "A Fair Fight" node. Line 1 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Everyone wants the Crown. I only want to be worthy of it.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (earnest, polite, quietly stubborn).

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "A Fair Fight" node. Line 2 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: A promise to himself: low and firm, not a shout.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "A Fair Fight" node. Line 3 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: A worthy Sovereign does not throw their Crown away to win. Keep it whole.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (earnest, polite, quietly stubborn).

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "A Hundred Paces" node. Line 1 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Something circles high above the Arena.
lines.direction: Storyteller, warm and measured.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "A Hundred Paces" node. Line 2 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Signature line, fully in character (relaxed, friendly, dryly funny).

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "A Hundred Paces" node. Line 3 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Flyers can only be stopped by flyers, or by an archer with Reach. Keep me standing.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (relaxed, friendly, dryly funny).

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Who Needs Mending?" node. Line 1 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: You arrive late, your banner already bloodied.
lines.direction: Urgent but contained.

lines.speaker: Elara
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Who Needs Mending?" node. Line 2 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: A real question, in character.

lines.speaker: Elara
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Who Needs Mending?" node. Line 3 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: You are behind. Good. That is when we learn who we really are.
lines.direction: Brisk; warmer on the last sentence.

lines.speaker: Solara
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Novice's Test" node. Line 1 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: The Wardens want to see if you can break a wall of light.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (gentle, earnest, quietly stubborn).

lines.speaker: Solara
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Novice's Test" node. Line 2 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Signature line, fully in character (gentle, earnest, quietly stubborn).

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The List" node. Line 1 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Solenne swore to burn away every shadow in the Crownfall. She has started a list.
lines.direction: Storyteller with dry wit; a small pause before the final turn.

lines.speaker: Solenne Ash
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The List" node. Line 2 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Your name is not on it. Yet. Show me why it should stay off.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (blunt, loyal, impatient).

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Seeker's Test" node. Line 1 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Signature line, fully in character (earnest, polite, quietly stubborn).

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Seeker's Test" node. Line 2 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Trade well. Block well. That is all a duel is.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (earnest, polite, quietly stubborn).

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Longbow's Test" node. Line 1 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Signature line, fully in character (relaxed, friendly, dryly funny).

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Longbow's Test" node. Line 2 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: The Arena has raised its banners. Every shard you break pays you back.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (relaxed, friendly, dryly funny).

lines.speaker: Elara
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Surgeon's Test" node. Line 1 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Signature line, fully in character (brisk, practical, warm underneath).

lines.speaker: Elara
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Surgeon's Test" node. Line 2 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: My soldiers keep coming back. Can you keep up?
lines.direction: A real question, in character.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Two Crowns" node. Line 1 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Aurelia already has a crown. She wants to know why this one is bigger.
lines.direction: Storyteller with dry wit; a small pause before the final turn.

lines.speaker: Aurelia
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Two Crowns" node. Line 2 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Projected battle cry: energetic, not screamed.

lines.speaker: Aurelia
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Two Crowns" node. Line 3 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Prove your banner is worth the Kingdom’s time. Lose no more than two shards.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (commanding, quick-witted, proud, fair).

lines.speaker: Aurelia
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Rally to Me" node. Line 1 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Projected battle cry: energetic, not screamed.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Rally to Me" node. Line 2 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Kael and Rowan take the field at your side. The Arena pours its Command into both armies.
lines.direction: Storyteller, warm and measured.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Unbroken Line" node. Line 1 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Varr has held every line he was given. He was never given the Crown.
lines.direction: Storyteller with dry wit; a small pause before the final turn.

lines.speaker: General Varr
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Unbroken Line" node. Line 2 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Projected battle cry: energetic, not screamed.

lines.speaker: General Varr
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Unbroken Line" node. Line 3 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: A wall cannot be pushed. It can only be gone around.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (gruff, patient, steady).

lines.speaker: General Varr
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Nine Days at the Bridge" node. Line 1 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Signature line, fully in character (gruff, patient, steady).

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Nine Days at the Bridge" node. Line 2 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Blood & Ember pours across the bridge. Varr stands beside you. Hold until the sixth round begins.
lines.direction: Clear and steady: the instruction is plain, not dramatic.

lines.speaker: General Varr
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Before the Light" node. Line 1 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Projected battle cry: energetic, not screamed.

lines.speaker: General Varr
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Before the Light" node. Line 2 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Beyond this gate waits the First Light. Show me you can hold a line before you face it.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (gruff, patient, steady).

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Crowning: Sol" node. Line 1 of 4, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: The gate opens on light so bright the shadows forget where to stand.
lines.direction: Hushed awe; slow, as if shielding your eyes.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Crowning: Sol" node. Line 2 of 4, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Before anything, there was Sol. Sol would like it back that way.
lines.direction: Hushed and slow; leave space around it.

lines.speaker: Sol
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Crowning: Sol" node. Line 3 of 4, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Soft, ancient, faintly amused: a reminder, not a threat.

lines.speaker: Sol
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Crowning: Sol" node. Line 4 of 4, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Show me what you would do with the morning, Sovereign.
lines.direction: Gentle and curious. Unsettlingly calm.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: OPTIONAL title card: the Chapter Two prologue panel opens, before its first line.
lines.direction: Title card: clear and ceremonial. Read it as "Chapter Two. Blood and Ember."

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Prologue panel opens (automatically on the first visit to Chapter 2, or via the "Prologue" button). Line 1 of 3, in order.
lines.text: Sol has seen what your banner can do. Word travels fast in the Crownfall, and it reaches the wild places first.
lines.direction: Opening of the chapter: unhurried, set the scene.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Prologue panel opens (automatically on the first visit to Chapter 2, or via the "Prologue" button). Line 2 of 3, in order.
lines.text: Every dragon died for the Crown. Aurex is here to find out whether it was worth it.
lines.direction: Storyteller with dry wit; a small pause before the final turn.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Prologue panel opens (automatically on the first visit to Chapter 2, or via the "Prologue" button). Line 3 of 3, in order.
lines.text: Before the last dragon will face you, the beasts and the fires of the Crownfall want to see if you can keep up.
lines.direction: Storyteller, warm and measured.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Red Moon Rising" node. Line 1 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Fen tracks weakness. He learned it from the winters, and the winters were thorough.
lines.direction: Storyteller with dry wit; a small pause before the final turn.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Red Moon Rising" node. Line 2 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Signature line, fully in character (quiet, watchful, blunt).

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Red Moon Rising" node. Line 3 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: You start behind. Good. The pack hunts hardest when it is hungry.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (quiet, watchful, blunt).

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Mountain" node. Line 1 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Grizz does not understand the Crown. He understands that everyone wants it, and he likes a crowd.
lines.direction: Storyteller with dry wit; a small pause before the final turn.

lines.speaker: Grizz
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Mountain" node. Line 2 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: A big, joyful roar.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Mountain" node. Line 3 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Grizz plants himself in front of your Crown. Let him block.
lines.direction: Clear and steady: the instruction is plain, not dramatic.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "One, Two, Three" node. Line 1 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Rask counts in threes. So do his opponents, briefly.
lines.direction: Storyteller with dry wit; a small pause before the final turn.

lines.speaker: Rask
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "One, Two, Three" node. Line 2 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Slow and counted, one beat per word, a faint hiss.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Too Close to the Spell" node. Line 1 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: She was a candle once. Then someone read a spell too close to her.
lines.direction: Storyteller with dry wit; a small pause before the final turn.

lines.speaker: Emberling
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Too Close to the Spell" node. Line 2 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: A real question, in character.

lines.speaker: Emberling
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "Too Close to the Spell" node. Line 3 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Scorch takes away Guard. Little champions melt. Big ones get worried!
lines.direction: Projected battle cry: energetic, not screamed.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Silence" node. Line 1 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Mirella can hear every ocean. The Crownfall has none, and the silence frightens her.
lines.direction: Storyteller with dry wit; a small pause before the final turn.

lines.speaker: Mirella
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Silence" node. Line 2 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Signature line, fully in character (gentle, thoughtful, a little shy, deeply caring).

lines.speaker: Mirella
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Silence" node. Line 3 of 3, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Stand with me until the fire runs out.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (gentle, thoughtful, a little shy, deeply caring).

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Pack’s Test" node. Line 1 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Signature line, fully in character (quiet, watchful, blunt).

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Pack’s Test" node. Line 2 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: Keep your blockers standing. We strike what is already tired.
lines.direction: Conversational, in character (quiet, watchful, blunt).

lines.speaker: Grizz
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Bear’s Test" node. Line 1 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: An even bigger, happier roar.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Bear’s Test" node. Line 2 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: A wall of fur and stone. You will not push through it. Go around.
lines.direction: Clear and steady: the instruction is plain, not dramatic.

lines.speaker: Rask
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Pit Champion’s Test" node. Line 1 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.direction: Signature line, fully in character (calm, confident, a little theatrical).

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Pit Champion’s Test" node. Line 2 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
lines.text: The pits pay for every shard broken. Rask has never left them hungry.
lines.direction: Storyteller, warm and measured.

lines.speaker: Emberling
lines.trigger: Story panel opens when the player taps the "The Spark’s Test" node. Line 1 of 2, in order; stops if the panel closes or the Bout begins.
